findings.problem: “Pennyroyal never goes near food” is not true as history; the World Table Mint lexicon gives it as a rule, never cook with pennyroyal.

The World Table Mint lexicon says to steep mint below the boil because boiled mint goes bitter, against the Library card’s full boil for herbals; the fragment left that disagreement silent. “The bar’s mojito sprigs” also implied house stock.
findings.change: The fresh sprig line now says to steep it below the boil (the lexicon’s rule, written for the fresh herb); dried peppermint keeps the Library’s full boil. Dropped “the bar’s”.
